title: Legal notice
intro: Important information about SoccerOctopus predictions, market estimates, and responsible use.

predictions.title: 1. Nature of predictions
predictions.body: SoccerOctopus provides probabilistic predictions generated by a swarm of AI agents using statistical models, historical data, team form, and tactical analysis. All predictions are approximations only and are not guarantees of any outcome. Football matches are inherently unpredictable and actual results may differ significantly from any prediction made by this platform.

advice.title: 2. Not financial or betting advice
advice.body: Nothing on SoccerOctopus constitutes financial advice, betting advice, or a recommendation to place any wager. Predictions are provided solely as informational tools to assist users in forming their own independent judgement. You should never bet more than you can afford to lose.

liability.title: 3. Limitation of liability
liability.body: SoccerOctopus and its operators accept no responsibility or liability for any financial loss, damage, or harm arising directly or indirectly from the use of predictions or market estimates published on this platform. Use of this service is entirely at your own risk.

regulations.title: 4. Gambling regulations
regulations.body: Betting and gambling may be regulated or prohibited in your jurisdiction. It is your sole responsibility to ensure that any betting activity you undertake complies with the laws applicable in your country or region. SoccerOctopus does not operate as a bookmaker, exchange, or licensed gambling operator.

affiliation.title: 5. No affiliation with FIFA, Kalshi, or Polymarket
affiliation.body: SoccerOctopus is an independent platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected in any form to FIFA (Fédération Internationale de Football Association), Kalshi, or Polymarket.
